label: Silhouette Score
description: Measures how similar a data point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. Higher values indicate better-defined clusters.

interpretation.meaning: Clusters are well separated and clearly defined.
interpretation.recommendation: No major changes needed. Clustering is highly reliable.

interpretation.meaning: Clusters are reasonably well separated with slight overlap.
interpretation.recommendation: Acceptable result. Minor tuning may improve segmentation.

interpretation.meaning: Clusters have noticeable overlap and are not very distinct.
interpretation.recommendation: Consider tuning parameters or trying a different clustering model.

interpretation.meaning: Clusters are poorly defined and overlapping significantly.
interpretation.recommendation: Re-evaluate features or increase/decrease number of clusters.

interpretation.meaning: Data points may be assigned to wrong clusters.
interpretation.recommendation: Clustering is not reliable. Try a different model or preprocessing approach.

business_mapping: Indicates how clearly customer segments are separated from each other.

ui_display.tooltip: Higher score means better cluster separation
